table ip filter {
	set trusted {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		elements = { 192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.7 }
	}

	map svc {
		type inet_service : verdict
		elements = { 5432 : accept,
			     6379 : drop,
			     7000 : jump guard }
	}

	chain INPUT {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		iifname "lo" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		xt match "conntrack" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		xt match "conntrack" counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		ip saddr 198.51.100.0/24 ip protocol tcp xt match "multiport" counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump web
		ip protocol icmp xt match "icmp" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		udp dport 53 xt match "comment" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		tcp flags & (fin | syn | rst | ack) == syn tcp dport 8443 limit rate 10/second burst 5 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		tcp dport 9100 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "REJECT"
		tcp dport { 25, 587 } accept
		ip saddr @trusted tcp dport 3306 accept
		tcp dport vmap @svc
		ip saddr . tcp dport { 198.51.100.7 . 9000, 192.0.2.0/24 . 9001-9010 } accept
		iifname { "docker0", "eth1" } udp dport 123 accept
		udp dport vmap { 161 : accept, 162 : drop }
		tcp dport 2000-2100 jump guard
		ip saddr 198.51.100.8 ip saddr 198.51.100.9 tcp dport 4000 accept
		ip saddr 203.0.113.0/24 tcp dport 4001 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept comment "plain rule made with nft"
		iifname "eth1" tcp dport 4002 accept
		jump extra
	}

	chain FORWARD {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
		iifname "eth1" oifname "eth0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
		xt match "conntrack" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
	}

	chain OUTPUT {
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
	}

	chain web {
		ip saddr 198.51.100.66 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept
	}

	chain guard {
		tcp dport 2000-2100 counter packets 0 bytes 0 return
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop
	}

	chain extra {
		ip saddr 203.0.113.99 drop
		tcp dport 3000 accept
	}
}
table ip nat {
	chain PREROUTING {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		iifname "eth0" tcp dport 8080 counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "DNAT"
	}

	chain POSTROUTING {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		ip saddr 172.17.0.0/16 oifname "eth0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 xt target "MASQUERADE"
	}
}
